articles.title: Citigroup Lawsuit Raises Questions For Long Term Culture And Returns
articles.mainIdea: Citigroup Lawsuit Raises Questions For Long Term Culture And Returns
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Citigroup Lawsuit Raises Questions For Long Term Culture And Returns. A former Citigroup managing director has filed a lawsuit alleging sexual harassment by the bank's Head of Wealth, wrongful termination, and a hostile work environment. Citigroup is contesting the claims, seeking to move the case to arbitration, while the CEO has voiced confidence in the bank's internal investigation. The case places Citigroup's corporate culture, governance practices, and executive accountability under closer public and regulatory scrutiny. For investors watching NYSE:C,...
